```{r}
m <- 10
league_avg <- mean(training$outcome, na.rm = TRUE)

set.seed(42)
folds <- createFolds(training$outcome, k = 5, list = TRUE)

training$shooter_efficiency <- NA_real_
training$defensive_efficiency <- NA_real_

for (fold_idx in seq_along(folds)) {
  val_indices <- folds[[fold_idx]]
  tr_data <- training[-val_indices, ]
  
  shooter_stats <- tr_data %>%
    group_by(shooter_id) %>%
    summarize(
      total_shots = n(),
      total_makes = sum(outcome),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  defender_stats <- tr_data %>%
    filter(contested == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(closestdef_id) %>%
    summarize(
      total_contests = n(),
      makes_allowed = sum(outcome),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  fold_df <- training[val_indices, ]
  
  fold_df <- fold_df %>%
    left_join(shooter_stats, by = "shooter_id") %>%
    left_join(defender_stats, by = "closestdef_id") %>%
    mutate(
      shooter_eff = (coalesce(total_makes, 0) + m * league_avg) / (coalesce(total_shots, 0) + m),
      def_eff = case_when(
        contested == FALSE ~ league_avg,
        TRUE ~ (coalesce(makes_allowed, 0) + m * league_avg) / (coalesce(total_contests, 0) + m)
      )
    )
  
  training$shooter_efficiency[val_indices]   <- fold_df$shooter_eff
  training$defensive_efficiency[val_indices] <- fold_df$def_eff
}
```

```{r}
#Prep Variables

prepare_features <- function(df) {
  shoot_eff_vec <- if ("shooter_efficiency" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$shooter_efficiency
  } else {
    rep(league_avg, nrow(df))
  }

  def_eff_vec <- if ("defensive_efficiency" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$defensive_efficiency
  } else if ("defender_efficiency" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$defender_efficiency
  } else {
    rep(league_avg, nrow(df))
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      # Offense Variables
      locationx           = as.numeric(locationx),
      locationy           = as.numeric(locationy),
      distance            = as.numeric(distance),
      dribblesbefore      = as.numeric(dribblesbefore),
      shotclock           = as.numeric(shotclock),
      shooterspeed        = as.numeric(shooterspeed),
      three               = as.numeric(three),
      shottype_num        = as.numeric(factor(shottype)),
      gamestate_num       = as.numeric(factor(gamestate)),
      shooter_efficiency  = coalesce(as.numeric(shoot_eff_vec), league_avg),
      dist_to_rim         = sqrt((locationx - (-41.75))^2 + (locationy - 0)^2),
      shot_angle          = abs(atan2(locationy, locationx - (-41.75))),
      is_behind_backboard = as.numeric(locationx < -43.75),
      backboard_depth     = pmax(0, -43.75 - locationx),
      
      # Defense Variables
      num_contesters       = as.numeric(num_contesters),
      contested            = as.numeric(contested),
      closestdefdist       = as.numeric(closestdefdist),
      defensive_efficiency = coalesce(as.numeric(def_eff_vec), league_avg),
      distcont1_clean      = ifelse(is.na(distcont1), 99, as.numeric(distcont1)),
      def_closing_speed    = sapply(closestdefapproach, function(arr) {
        if (is.null(arr) || length(arr) < 4) return(0)
        return(as.numeric(arr[1]) - as.numeric(arr[4])) 
      })
    )
}

offense_vars <- c("dribblesbefore", "shotclock", "shooterspeed", "three", 
                  "shottype_num", "gamestate_num", "shooter_efficiency", 
                  "dist_to_rim", "shot_angle", "backboard_depth", "is_behind_backboard")

defense_vars <- c("num_contesters", "contested", "closestdefdist", 
                  "distcont1_clean", "def_closing_speed", "defensive_efficiency")

combined_vars <- c(offense_vars, defense_vars)
```

```{r}
# 5. Model Validation Split
future_training <- training
future_testing  <- testing

future_training_prep <- prepare_features(future_training %>% filter(!is.na(outcome)))

set.seed(42)
split_idx <- 1:212859

training_training_tree <- future_training_prep[split_idx, ]
training_testing_tree  <- future_training_prep[(max(split_idx) + 1):nrow(future_training_prep), ]

# Median Imputation for missing values across predictor variables
for (var in combined_vars) {
  if (any(is.na(training_training_tree[[var]]))) {
    med_val <- median(training_training_tree[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    training_training_tree[[var]][is.na(training_training_tree[[var]])] <- med_val
    training_testing_tree[[var]][is.na(training_testing_tree[[var]])]   <- med_val
  }
}

training_training_tree$outcome_factor <- as.factor(training_training_tree$outcome)
training_testing_tree$outcome_factor  <- as.factor(training_testing_tree$outcome)

training_training_tree$shot_weight <- case_when(
  training_training_tree$dist_to_rim <= 4  ~ 0.5,
  training_training_tree$dist_to_rim <= 15 ~ 1.0,
  TRUE                                     ~ 1.5
)
```

```{r}
# 6. Light GBM Mode `
X_train_comb <- as.matrix(training_training_tree[, combined_vars])
y_train      <- training_training_tree$outcome

X_test_comb  <- as.matrix(training_testing_tree[, combined_vars])
y_test       <- training_testing_tree$outcome

dtrain_comb <- lgb.Dataset(data = X_train_comb, label = y_train)

lgb_params <- list(
  objective = "binary",
  metric = "binary_logloss",
  boosting_type = "gbdt",
  learning_rate = 0.03,
  num_leaves = 15,            
  max_depth = 5,
  min_data_in_leaf = 100,    
  feature_fraction = 0.5,     
  bagging_fraction = 0.8,
  bagging_freq = 1
)

combined_lgb_model <- lgb.train(
  params = lgb_params,
  data = dtrain_comb,
  nrounds = 200
)

lgb_preds <- predict(combined_lgb_model, X_test_comb)
```

```{r}
# Random forest model
forest_formula <- as.formula(paste("outcome_factor ~", paste(combined_vars, collapse = " + ")))

random_forest_model <- randomForest(
  formula      = forest_formula,
  data         = training_training_tree,
  ntree        = 100,
  importance   = TRUE,
  case.weights = training_training_tree$shot_weight
)

raw_rf_probs <- predict(random_forest_model, newdata = training_testing_tree, type = "prob")

if ("1" %in% colnames(raw_rf_probs)) {
  rf_preds <- raw_rf_probs[, "1"]
} else if ("TRUE" %in% colnames(raw_rf_probs)) {
  rf_preds <- raw_rf_probs[, "TRUE"]
} else {
  rf_preds <- raw_rf_probs[, 2]
}
```

```{r}
#Finding optimal blending weight
calc_log_loss <- function(actual, pred, eps = 1e-15) {
  pred <- pmin(pmax(pred, eps), 1 - eps)
  -mean(actual * log(pred) + (1 - actual) * log(1 - pred))
}

eps <- 1e-15
lgb_preds_clean <- pmin(pmax(lgb_preds, eps), 1 - eps)
rf_preds_clean  <- pmin(pmax(rf_preds, eps), 1 - eps)

lgb_loss <- calc_log_loss(y_test, lgb_preds_clean)
rf_loss  <- calc_log_loss(y_test, rf_preds_clean)

cat(sprintf("Standalone LightGBM Log Loss:      %.5f\n", lgb_loss))
cat(sprintf("Standalone Random Forest Log Loss:  %.5f\n\n", rf_loss))

best_weight <- 0.0
best_blend_loss <- lgb_loss

for (w_rf in seq(0, 0.50, by = 0.01)) {
  w_lgb <- 1 - w_rf
  blended_preds <- (w_lgb * lgb_preds_clean) + (w_rf * rf_preds_clean)
  current_loss <- calc_log_loss(y_test, blended_preds)
  
  if (current_loss < best_blend_loss) {
    best_blend_loss <- current_loss
    best_weight <- w_rf
  }
}

cat(sprintf("Best Optimization Results:\n"))
cat(sprintf("LightGBM Weight:      %.2f%%\n", (1 - best_weight) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Random Forest Weight: %.2f%%\n", best_weight * 100))
cat(sprintf("New Blended Log Loss: %.5f\n", best_blend_loss))
```

```{r}

full_train_prep <- prepare_features(future_training %>% filter(!is.na(outcome)))
test_prep       <- prepare_features(testing)

for (var in combined_vars) {
  if (any(is.na(full_train_prep[[var]]))) {
    med_val <- median(full_train_prep[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    full_train_prep[[var]][is.na(full_train_prep[[var]])] <- med_val
    
    if (var %in% colnames(test_prep)) {
      test_prep[[var]][is.na(test_prep[[var]])] <- med_val
    }
  }
}

full_train_prep$outcome_factor <- as.factor(full_train_prep$outcome)
full_train_prep$shot_weight <- case_when(
  full_train_prep$dist_to_rim <= 4  ~ 0.5,
  full_train_prep$dist_to_rim <= 15 ~ 1.0,
  TRUE                              ~ 1.5
)

X_full_train <- as.matrix(full_train_prep[, combined_vars])
y_full_train <- full_train_prep$outcome
X_final_test <- as.matrix(test_prep[, combined_vars])

dtrain_full <- lgb.Dataset(data = X_full_train, label = y_full_train)

final_lgb <- lgb.train(
  params = lgb_params,
  data = dtrain_full,
  nrounds = 200
)
final_lgb_probs <- predict(final_lgb, X_final_test)

final_rf <- randomForest(
  formula      = forest_formula,
  data         = full_train_prep,
  ntree        = 100,
  importance   = TRUE,
  case.weights = full_train_prep$shot_weight
)

final_rf_raw <- predict(final_rf, newdata = test_prep, type = "prob")
if ("1" %in% colnames(final_rf_raw)) {
  final_rf_probs <- final_rf_raw[, "1"]
} else if ("TRUE" %in% colnames(final_rf_raw)) {
  final_rf_probs <- final_rf_raw[, "TRUE"]
} else {
  final_rf_probs <- final_rf_raw[, 2]
}

#Blending random forest and lightgbm models
w_rf  <- best_weight
w_lgb <- 1 - best_weight

final_blend <- (w_lgb * final_lgb_probs) + (w_rf * final_rf_probs)
final_blend <- pmin(pmax(final_blend, eps), 1 - eps)

submission_df <- data.frame(
  id = if ("id" %in% colnames(testing)) testing$id else seq_len(nrow(testing)),
  outcome = final_blend
)

write.csv(submission_df, "submission.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("==========================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Successfully generated submissions.csv with %d rows!\n", nrow(submission_df)))
cat("==========================================\n")
```
